column1: # p503 2026-10-28 — the recency axis: slice supply by CREATION DATE instead of by topic.
# Rationale: Gap 500-A/501-A/502's censuses all sliced by topic and found the axes exhausted.

# Reading: 0/24 novel on the top-star slices of a 90-day and a 180-day window.
